item.title: Causeartist Weekly #309: The $1.2B Grocery Model Investors Rejected 50 Times + $500M for Clean Energy Infrastructure
item.description: This week: Obvious Ventures closes $360M for planetary health, Daphni backs science-based startups with €260M, and Stanford hosts a career fair connecting mission-driven talent with purpose-first employers.

item.title: IBM Opens $45M AI Accelerator for Education and Workforce Nonprofits
item.description: IBM launched a global RFP for its Impact Accelerator program, seeking nonprofits and government organizations to develop AI-driven solutions for education and workforce development. Selected organizations receive two-year grants including watsonx access and IBM consulting support.

item.title: Builders Vision Acquires Stake in Hatch Blue to Scale Sustainable Aquaculture
item.description: Builders Vision takes minority GP stake in Hatch Blue, the Ireland-based aquaculture investment platform behind the €93M Blue Revolution Fund.

item.title: Aquaculture: Definition, Types, and Why It Matters
item.description: Aquaculture is the controlled cultivation of fish, shellfish, seaweed, and other aquatic organisms. Now producing more seafood than wild fisheries, it represents a critical growth sector for impact investors.

item.title: Causeartist Weekly #310: Regenerating Seas, Forests, and Grids: Re‑Wiring Our Planet’s Operating System
item.description: Builders Vision takes GP stake in Hatch Blue as aquaculture hits $310B. Plus: The full Aspiration fraud case study, IBM's $45M AI accelerator for nonprofits, and climate tech funding rounds from Enerlink, Unergy, and Uplift360.

item.title: Tony's Chocolonely: Impact Business Case Study
item.description: Deep dive into Tony's Chocolonely's mission to end slavery in chocolate. Revenue model, supply chain innovation, impact metrics, and lessons from building ethical chocolate at scale.

item.title: Inside Lupus Ventures and the Push to Fund Cures First
item.description: Lupus has long been one of medicine’s most complex and underfunded diseases. Now, with a stronger clinical pipeline and growing industry interest, Lupus Ventures is stepping in to close the funding gap and prioritize return on mission over return on capital.

item.title: How AidKit Is Modernizing Aid Distribution With Technical Infrastructure
item.description: AidKit builds the infrastructure that helps governments and nonprofits get money into the hands of people who need it, faster and with less fraud. CEO Brittany talks through the business model, the AI fraud challenge, and what the next five years look like.

item.title: What Is Waste-to-Energy? Definition, Methods, and Impact
item.description: Waste-to-Energy converts municipal solid waste into electricity, heat, or fuel. Learn how WtE works, its role in the circular economy, and key impact considerations.

item.title: Causeartist Weekly #311: Ethical Chocolate, Clean Energy AI, and Sustainable Farm Grants
item.description: Modernizing old industries: Tony’s Chocolonely’s ethical supply chain, AidKit’s $385M AI-driven aid, and Lupus Ventures’ new fund. Plus, $115M for Zanskar’s geothermal AI, $10M in agtech grants, and $250K opportunities from Morgan Stanley.
